prompt.project_info: Ultra-realistic candid portrait on a windswept beach under a cloudy sky.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult blonde woman with long hair tied back and loose windblown strands, natural makeup-free appearance, athletic feminine silhouette and no visible tattoos, wearing a beige triangle bikini with thin straps and small gold hoop earrings; one hand adjusts the side tie while she looks toward ocean.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 4:5 medium shot from mid-thigh up, subject slightly right-facing, turquoise waves, wet sand, rocky outcrop and heavy grey cloud cover behind.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused overcast daylight, even flattering illumination, natural skin and muscle texture, quiet fresh windswept beach mood.
prompt.technical_specs: High-resolution photorealistic photography, sharp subject, slightly softened but detailed ocean background, natural perspective and realistic hair movement.
